verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs claim flags toggle behavior in real time and offer an emergency switch that turns off a code branch immediately, which covers the kill-switch intent. The pack never describes how connected SDKs receive changes (no streaming, no polling interval, no propagation latency), and SDKs are said to evaluate locally after initialization. Missing for 10: documented streaming or polling update mechanism for server and client SDKs, a stated propagation time in seconds, and hands-on corroboration that a kill switch takes effect in already-connected SDKs.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
